_comment: Applied by seed.ts and the build_* scripts. junkPatterns are case-insensitive regex fragments matched against course name (test/admin/duplicate/non-golf ForeUp accounts). privateClubs are members-only MA clubs with no public tee times — excluded per 'public courses only'. Semi-private courses that sell public tee times are intentionally KEPT. `closed` (permanently closed) and `knownGap` (a public course we knowingly cannot cover) are reasoned exemptions read ONLY by scripts/audit_coverage.ts: a roster course listed here counts as reconciled instead of failing the coverage gate. Each entry is {name, reason}.

knownGap.name: St. Marks Golf Club at St Marks School
knownGap.reason: same physical course as 'Southborough Golf Club' (identical address/rating/website southboroughgolfclub.com) under a different roster name — already covered live via golfrev under ma-southborough-golf-club; kept as a separate roster line item because the two names don't share enough tokens for the automatic town-grouped dedupe (lib/dedupe.ts sameCourse()) to merge them

knownGap.name: Lynnfield Center Golf Club
knownGap.reason: same physical course as 'Reedy Meadow Golf Course' (identical google_rating/google_reviews/score, coords ~0.5mi apart, both part of the town's lynnfieldgolf.com two-course operation) under an old/alternate name — already covered live via foreup under ma-reedy-meadow-golf-course; name dissimilarity prevented the automatic town-grouped dedupe from merging them

knownGap.name: Crystal Springs Golf Club
knownGap.reason: same physical course as 'Crystal Lake Golf Club' (identical website crystallake-golf.com, google_rating/reviews/score) under an old/alternate name — already covered live via teeitup under ma-crystal-lake-golf-club; found via a catalog-wide sweep for fallback/live pairs sharing identical rating+review+score in the same town

knownGap.name: Wading River Golf Course
knownGap.reason: same physical course as 'Links at Mass Golf' (identical website linksatmassgolf.org, google_rating/reviews/score) under an old/alternate name — already covered live via foreup under ma-links-at-mass-golf; found via the same catalog-wide duplicate sweep

knownGap.name: Woodbriar - Falmouth
knownGap.reason: same physical course as 'Falmouth Country Club' (identical website falmouthcountryclub.com, google_rating/reviews/score) under an old/alternate name — already covered live via chronogolf under ma-falmouth-country-club (confirmed in iter16 recon before the catalog-wide sweep found it independently)

knownGap.name: Edgewood Golf Club
knownGap.reason: duplicate/mislabeled entry for the real course at 161 Sheep Pasture Rd, Southwick, MA (covered live via foreup as ma-edgewood-golf-course-ma, identical courseId/scheduleId/bookingClass) — the 'Auburn, MA' town this roster line claims is wrong; verified via web search there is no Edgewood golf course in Auburn MA, only a same-name course in Auburn, ILLINOIS (golfedgewood.com) that this line was likely conflated with

knownGap.name: Green Hill Golf Course (MA)
knownGap.reason: same physical course as 'Worcester Green Hill Municipal Golf Club' (identical courseId/scheduleId 21206/7270) under a shorter/alternate name — kept the Worcester-named record since it has a real street address (2 Green Hill Ave) and explicit bookingClass; already covered live via foreup

knownGap.name: Olde Scotland Links
knownGap.reason: same physical course as 'Olde Scotland Links at Bridgewater' (identical teeitup facility 15419) under a shorter name — kept the '...at Bridgewater' record since it carries a real street address (690 Pine St) from the golfmassachusetts roster source; already covered live via teeitup

knownGap.name: River Bend Country Club
